title: Automatic on-the-fly video editing tool!
summary: carykh demonstrates a script that speeds up the silent parts of a video while leaving speech at normal speed, to condense lectures and similar footage. It later became the Jumpcutter tool.
why: Referenced as the origin of automatic silence-skipping video editing and as a comparison for similar tools.

quote.text: A YouTuber (carykh) made a video where he explains an algorithm he made to automatically process lecture videos
